claimBoundary: This ledger defines evidence to collect. It contains no live route, callback, scheduler, credential, consumer, traffic, backup, retention, or owner findings.

sourceDocuments.use: Current issue scope and acceptance criteria; issue was open with implementation and validations pending.
Milestone checklist and production-operation authorization boundary.
Staged decommission, retention, recovery, and shared callback constraints.
Functional review roles and shared root-token dependency risk.

evidenceDomains.subject: PHP/Hostinger route, rewrite, redirect, and error behavior used by migrated functions
requiredEvidence: Sanitized live inventory of route and rewrite rules with responsible environment and capture time.
Access and outcome evidence over a window that covers relevant traffic, scheduled work, support, and reauthentication cadence.
Per-route mapping to replacement behavior, safe redirect/error behavior, rollback trigger, and accountable operator.

evidenceDomains.subject: App-level callbacks, supported per-asset overrides, webhook subscriptions, and downstream consumers
requiredEvidence: Sanitized app-level and per-asset callback configuration, subscription state, and ownership for each relevant environment.
Delivery/consumer traces over an agreed observation window and proof of single execution per business action.
Validated gateway or cutover routing, signature handling, idempotency, rollback, and operator sign-off.

evidenceDomains.subject: Hostinger cron, external schedulers, recurring workers, and periodic reauthentication work
requiredEvidence: Sanitized scheduler inventory with cadence, last execution outcomes, side effects, and owner for every job.
Observation window covering each relevant cadence and periodic reauthentication or reconciliation behavior.
Replacement/disable order, alerting, and recoverable rollback evidence.

evidenceDomains.subject: GeneralSettings and any global/root credential source or fallback, without credential values
requiredEvidence: Sanitized inventory of credential identifiers/versions and scope from the authorized secret inventory; never record values.
Code/config ownership and read/write/fallback mapping, including whether credentials serve other apps or resources.
Approved replacement and selective revocation plan with verified non-impact to unrelated consumers.

evidenceDomains.subject: All products, services, integrations, and jobs that consume a global/root token or equivalent shared credential
requiredEvidence: Consumer-to-credential-scope map with owner, purpose, environment, and evidence source for each consumer.
Proof that each migrated function uses an authorized tenant/resource grant and no inappropriate global-token fallback.
Impact review for non-Meta products and an explicit credential disposition approved by its owner.

evidenceDomains.subject: Msg4/Suite4, portal, API, projections, client/tenant readers and writers, and remaining PHP consumers
requiredEvidence: Complete consumer and writer matrix linked to tenant, function, and replacement contract, with evidence provenance.
Proof that migrated tenants have no unplanned legacy dependency and unmigrated tenants remain safely supported until their own cutover.
Independent checks for cross-tenant access, duplicate effects, and missing consumer coverage.

evidenceDomains.subject: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp exclusive, and WhatsApp Coexistence kept as distinct flows; multiple numbers/companies
requiredEvidence: Flow-specific end-to-end evidence for each of the four modalities in the approved test context.
Multi-company and multiple-number evidence, including Coexistence, authorization isolation, recovery, and no credential swapping.
Applicable M4/M5/M6 acceptance evidence and a reviewer decision for each unsupported or externally gated case.

evidenceDomains.subject: Order, observation window, and rollback for disabling old writers/routes, readers, and jobs
requiredEvidence: Approved window justified by observed route traffic, job cadence, reauthentication, callbacks, and support patterns.
Per-stage preconditions, monitored signals, abort thresholds with owners, and rollback procedure across code/schema/data/external effects.
Post-stage evidence that no unexpected dependency or duplicate business executor appeared.

evidenceDomains.subject: Preservation of Meta accounts, phone numbers, WABAs, subscriptions, and other assets during hosting decommission
requiredEvidence: Change plan proves host/route retirement is separate from deleting Meta assets or client connections.
Pre/post inventory comparison or equivalent authorized evidence proving no unintended asset deletion or subscription change.
Explicit approval for any separate Meta-side change, if one is later proposed.

evidenceDomains.subject: Approved backup, sanitized contract/archive, rollback, key recovery, and restore readiness before destructive action
requiredEvidence: Backup scope, integrity, destination, custody, and retained version confirmed for affected data and infrastructure.
Restore exercise in a clean isolated environment with required keys/jobs and comparison against approved recovery criteria.
Sanitized architecture/contract and migration ledger archive; no operational source or secret copied into the archive.

evidenceDomains.subject: Approved retention, access, export, and disposal of hosting data and artifacts
requiredEvidence: Named accountable owner and approved retention schedule for each affected data/artifact class.
Documented legal/business exceptions, access controls, export/restore needs, and disposal proof requirements.
Separate approved execution record for any future hosting shutdown or data deletion.

evidenceDomains.subject: Named operational and support owners, remaining cross-milestone gates, and final M6 acceptance
requiredEvidence: Named people assigned to operate, review, support, and approve; generic roles alone are insufficient for execution.
Verified M6.09/M5.07/M5.08/M5.09 evidence and all applicable milestone acceptance gates.
Final auditable change record, rollback/recovery outcome, and explicit closeout review.
